exchanges.response_text:
[[columns]]
name = "payment_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Primary key identifying each payment record."

[[columns]]
name = "order_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Foreign key referencing the associated order."

[[columns]]
name = "customer_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Foreign key referencing the customer who made the payment."

[[columns]]
name = "method"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Payment method used (e.g. credit card, bank transfer)."

[[columns]]
name = "paid_at"
type = "Timestamp"
nullable = true
description = "Timestamp when the payment was completed; nullable for pending payments."

[rules]
required = ["payment_id", "order_id", "customer_id"]
protected = ["payment_id", "order_id", "customer_id"]
